claims.quote: Selumetinib in Children with Inoperable Plexiform Neurofibromas.
CONCLUSIONS: In this phase 2 trial, most children with neurofibromatosis type 1 and inoperable plexiform neurofibromas had durable tumor shrinkage and clinical benefit from selumetinib.
